mapper.insert: insert into attempt ( attempt_no, exam_no, student_no, attempt_status, attempt_start, attempt_submit, attempt_score ) values ( #{attemptNo}, #{examNo}, #{studentNo}, #{attemptStatus}, systimestamp, null, null )
mapper.select: select a.account_name from student s join account a on s.account_no = a.account_no where s.student_no = #{studentNo}
